'''Karran beetles''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Karra]]. They used their large mandibles as weapons, and could do great damage to living flesh. The [[Karran]]s themselves learned how to control the beetles, and used them in battle against their enemies. [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droids]] were said to look like a mechanical cross between a [[Zalorian rock-lion]] and a Karran beetle.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|319|war-mount}}</ref>
